name: Wanjiru Kamau
headline: QA / Test Automation Engineer
summary: Detail-oriented QA Automation Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for web and API applications. Skilled in building robust CI/CD-integrated test frameworks using Selenium and Python, with a strong focus on improving release quality and reducing manual testing overhead.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Selenium-based automated test suites for web applications
Integrate automated tests into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with developers to identify and resolve defects early in the development cycle
Write and execute API test scripts using Python and Postman
Mentor junior QA testers on automation best practices
Developed automated regression test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Python
Participated in sprint planning and defined test strategies for new features
Executed manual and automated testing for web and mobile applications
Reported and tracked defects using Jira
Performed manual functional and regression testing on web applications
Assisted senior QA engineers in creating automated test scripts
Documented test cases and maintained test data sets
